channel.title: AI GridWatch — Indiana data center updates
channel.description: Data center moratoriums, proposals, and community-impact headlines for Indiana, from AI GridWatch.

item.title: Indianapolis: data center moratorium — Proposed
item.description: City-County Council voted 23-1 to advance a moratorium through end of 2027 to the Metropolitan Development Commission for final approval (vote scheduled Aug 19). Exempts three already-approved projects

item.title: Jeffersonville: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 1-year pause, 8-0; does not affect the Meta facility at River Ridge Commerce Center, which operates under federal/state military land-use authority

item.title: Warrick County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 180-day moratorium, unanimous; Area Plan Commission had separately tabled its data center ordinance in Jul and paused projects through Dec 2026

item.title: Boone County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 1-year moratorium in unincorporated areas, unanimous; 12th Indiana county to pause. Does not affect Meta's data centers (in incorporated Advance)

item.title: Grant County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 24-month moratorium; gives officials time to study zoning, land use, infrastructure, and gather public input

item.title: Fayette County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 1-year pause; no local policy governing data centers existed. Consultant developing a framework for the Area Plan Commission

item.title: Starke County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 1-year moratorium on hyperscale data center projects (>5,000 sq ft) in unincorporated areas. Plan commission recommended a 1-year extension in Jul 2026

item.title: Marshall County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Permanent ban — replaced a temporary moratorium with a prohibition in the county zoning ordinance. One of two IN counties (with Cass) to outright ban data centers

item.title: Cass County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Permanent ban on new data centers — one of two IN counties (with Marshall) to outright ban rather than pause

item.title: Dearborn County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Up to 1-year moratorium on rezoning for data centers, commercial solar, and battery storage. 1,700+ petition signatures. No data center applications had been submitted at the time

item.title: Putnam County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 1-year moratorium on data centers, solar, wind, and SMRs in unincorporated areas, 2-1. ~100 residents packed the meeting. EnergyRe subsequently withdrew a 150 MW solar farm proposal

item.title: White County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Temporary moratorium on data centers. Prompted by a proposed project near Wolcott; residents cited water availability and transparency concerns

item.title: Pulaski County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 12-month moratorium, APC recommended 5-0. Preemptive — no proposals submitted. County developing ordinance with setback, power, and water provisions. Extension reviewed Jul 2026

item.title: Fulton County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 1-year moratorium, 2-1. Triggered by proposed 500 MW / 300-acre Decennial Group campus. Data center study committee to examine economic and environmental impacts

item.title: Miami County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Moratorium on acceptance, processing, and approval of all data center applications and permits. Permanent zoning ordinance in development — public hearing scheduled Jul 20

item.title: New Albany: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Up to 1-year moratorium on facilities/campuses >100,000 sq ft, unanimous. Study of infrastructure, utility costs, environmental effects, and neighborhood character impacts

item.title: Merrillville: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 1-year moratorium running Jun 1, 2026 to May 31, 2027 — council explicitly wants to watch the campus under construction in neighbouring Hobart before writing rules
